diagnosis_options.name: Port scar tissue
diagnosis_options.description: Fibrous growth around an old interface site.

diagnosis_options.name: Burnt legacy socket
diagnosis_options.description: Previous implant overloaded; charred contacts in the cavity.

diagnosis_options.name: Neural rejection
diagnosis_options.description: Immune response against synthetic nerve tissue.

scar_tissue: Fibrous mass wrapped around an old port seat.
burnt_socket: Charred contacts and carbon scoring in the cavity.
neural_rejection: Swollen tissue and immune activity around the interface.

stages.title: PREPARE PATIENT
stages.instruction: HOLD to infuse sedative. Release inside the green band.

stages.title: INCISION
stages.instruction: Select SCALPEL. Drag along the guide from the marker.

stages.title: EXPOSE INTERFACE
stages.instruction: Select RETRACTOR. Tap each clamp point to open the site.

stages.title: REMOVE DAMAGED TISSUE
stages.instruction: Select CAUTERY. Hold on dark tissue to burn it. Avoid yellow nerves.

stages.title: INSTALL IMPLANT
stages.instruction: Select FORCEPS. Drag the implant into the socket, rotate to align, then SEAT.

stages.title: CONNECT NEURAL INTERFACE
stages.instruction: Select SPLICER. Drag each implant pin to the nerve with the same mark.

stages.title: CALIBRATE IMPLANT
stages.instruction: Slide to match the waves, then LOCK. 3 bands.

stages.title: CLOSE INCISION
stages.instruction: Select SUTURE. Tap the stitch points in numbered order.

diagnosis_options.name: Clean site
diagnosis_options.description: Healthy tissue, first install.

diagnosis_options.name: Old hardware remnants
diagnosis_options.description: Leftover mounts and dead leads from earlier chrome.

diagnosis_options.name: Scarred tissue
diagnosis_options.description: Fibrous scarring or necrosis at the site.

old_hardware: Metal fragments and dead leads in the site.
Old mounting bracket still bolted in place.
tissue_damage: Necrotic patches near the target area.
